wess_zumino.statement: Q Ob_3 + {I_3, Ob_2} = 0 (equivalently Q Ob_3 + {Ob_2, I_3} = 0; here {Ob_2, I_3} = {I_3, Ob_2})
wess_zumino.derivation: Q^2 = 0 applied to the three-leg part of lim_{eps->0} Q W(P(eps,infty), I - I^CT[eps]) = Ob_3 + B_{P(0,infty)}(Ob_2, I_3); Q B_{P(0,oo)}(Ob_2, I_3) = B_{P(0,oo)}(Q Ob_2, I_3) - B_{P(0,oo)}(Ob_2, Q I_3) - B_{K_0}(Ob_2, I_3) = {Ob_2, I_3} (Q P(0,oo) = K_0, Q Ob_2 = 0, Q I_3 = 0); the limit commutes with Q (local operator at fixed momenta). Hence automatic.
wess_zumino.sector: (c, c, A|_V) is the only sector reached: Q G1 = Q G3 = Q G4 = Q G5 = 0 identically (Q G1, Q G4 are multiples of int([c,c], d^*d^*dA) = 0); Q G2 != 0
wess_zumino.consequence: alpha_2 = 27/8 is forced by Ob_2; the computed alpha_2 = 27/8 satisfies it; alpha_1, alpha_3, alpha_4, alpha_5 are not constrained

regression_two_point.statement: I-a machinery (special u in [0,1], others [1,oo), masters J2) on the two legs (c at p, A|_V at -p) reproduces Step-1 special bubbles (a)-(e) of the (c, A|_V) obstruction (computed in Step 1 by a different eps-expansion, engine_b/r2_T2.py)

method_notes.defect_flow: Q W(P(eps,oo), J) = d/d delta W(P(eps,oo), J + delta D), D = Q J + 1/2{J,J}_eps + hbar Delta_eps J, J = I - I^CT[eps]. Writing {,}_eps = {,} + {,}_Khat, Khat = K_eps - K_0: D = [-Q I^CT - {I, I^CT}_0] + [1/2{J,J}_Khat + hbar Delta_Khat J] (CME, Delta_0 I = 0 by colour), and the second bracket flows to -d/d delta W(P + delta Khat, J) = hbar Delta_Khat W + 1/2{W,W}_Khat.  At order hbar with three legs: hbar Delta_Khat W_0 = I-a (1PI) + I-d (special bubble + bridge); {W_0^(3), W_1^(2) - I^CT_2}_Khat = I-b + III_Khat; trees: II-a = -Q I^CT_3, II-b = B_P(-Q I^CT_2, I_3), III_K0 = -{I_3, I^CT_2}.  Delta_eps I = 0 (self-contraction of a vertex gives tr ad = 0). Nothing else has three legs at order hbar.
method_notes.I_a_word_formula: coefficient of the odd r in leg order = sum_words sum_pos (1/(2n)) rsign (-1)^(odd legs before pos) colour(word) STr[X_0 Pi h_0 ... X_{n-1} Pi h_{n-1}], X_pos = fibre of K_0 (-identity; lambda: -(Mp^-1)^T) times (e^{-eps k^2}-1), other X = N(k) e^{-eps k^2}/k^2; toy-verified (engine_b/toy_r2.py) and reproducing the Step-1 special bubbles exactly (regression_two_point).
method_notes.schwinger_and_gaussian: (e^{-eps k^2}-1) = -int_0^eps k^2 e^{-t k^2} dt (special), e^{-eps k^2}/k^2 = int_eps^oo e^{-t k^2} dt; loop momentum Gaussian: (16 pi^2)^-1 T^-2 sum_k C_k(beta) (2T)^-k e^{-T rho}, rho = sum beta_e |P_e|^2 - |sum beta_e P_e|^2 >= 0 (a variance), beta_e = t_e/T. t = eps u: u_special in [0,1], u_e in [1,oo). C_k is homogeneous of degree deg(Num)-2k in the leg momenta, so the term (k, j) of e^{-eps T rho} carries eps^{E-2-k+j} and momentum degree omega + 2(E-2-k+j): only integer powers eps^n with momentum degree omega + 2n occur, no half-integer powers, no log eps.  eps^n coefficient = sum_k 2^-k (-1)^j/j! int du T^{-2-k+j} [C_k rho^j](beta), j = k+2-E+n.
method_notes.convergence: Large-u power counting: the eps^n integrand is bounded by const * T^{-E+n} * (polynomial in beta, bounded); the region has E-1 non-compact directions (u_special in [0,1]) and T >= E-1 >= 1, so int T^{-E+n} converges for n <= 0 (int r^{E-2} r^{-E} dr = int r^-2 dr). Termwise: a monomial u^alpha T^{-(E-n+|alpha|)} converges iff E - n + |alpha| > (sum of the non-compact exponents) + E - 1, true for n <= 0 (asserted for every master integral used: J3 needs m > a2+a3+2, J2 needs m > a2+1).  Remainder: |e^{-x} - sum_{j<=J} (-x)^j/j!| <= C x^{J+1/2} for x >= 0 bounds the error of the eps^0 truncation by const * eps^{1/2} * int T^{-E+1/2} < oo; hence graph(eps) = eps^-1 g_{-1} + g_0 + o(1) exactly, with g_0 the order-omega Taylor coefficient.  Numerically the remainder is O(eps log eps) (IR region: the special edge supplies an extra k^2, the non-analytic part of the eps = 1 graph starts at momentum degree omega + 2).  Two-edge special bubbles: the exponent t1 t2|p|^2/T <= eps|p|^2 is uniformly bounded, the graph is a power series in eps (used for D_2 to order eps after homogenising the beta-polynomials with sum beta = 1).
method_notes.masters_exact: J3(a1,a2,a3;m) and J2(a1,a2;m) in closed form (masters.py): u3 by binomial expansion around (S+u3)^-m (rational), u2 by w = 1+u1+u2 (all powers <= -2, no log), u1 by v = 2+u1 (J3) resp. v = 1+u1 (J2): the only transcendental is int_2^3 dv/v = log(3/2) (J3) resp. int_1^2 dv/v = log 2 (J2). Hence every coefficient lies in Q + Q log 2 + Q log 3 exactly; no integer-relation search was needed.  Second, independent evaluation: adaptive quadrature of the defining integrals (max relative difference 1.5e-12) and the finite-eps numerical evaluation of whole graphs without Taylor expansion (numeric_I_a_cApAp: 4.675873561680783 at eps = 1e-6 vs exact 4.675959263513780 for 11/4 + 19/4 log(3/2); differences 8.5e-3, 8.6e-4, 8.6e-5 at eps = 1e-4, 1e-5, 1e-6).
method_notes.structure_fit: per sector: random integer polarisations and momenta (seeded), exact linear algebra on the complete list of Spin(4) x Spin(6)-invariant multilinear forms of the right momentum degree (8 for (c,A|_V,A|_V) incl. eps(a1,a2,p1,p2); 3 for (c,A|_Wperp,A|_Wperp); 4 chiral forms for (c,lambda,lambda); 2 for (c,c,A*|_V)), then on G1..G5; residuals evaluated on all further configurations (11, 6, 8, 5 configurations): exactly 0 for every class and every total. The parity-odd structure (lambda1+,rho lambda2-) - (lambda1-, rho lambda2+) [chirality-odd] has coefficient 0 in every class.
method_notes.colour: abstract reduction for a general simple g (tr_g of three ad = (1/2) tr_g(ad_X ad_Y)/(X,Y) ([X0,X1],X2) with the word-order sign; quartic letters via ([,],[,]) keys) checked word by word against explicit traces in su(2) and su(3) with non-orthonormal bases and a rescaled pairing: identical multiples (+-1/2, +-1) of tr_g(ad ad)/(X,Y) ([c0,c1],c2) (colour_check).
method_notes.brackets: tree contractions B_K(f,g) = cross part of d_K(f g), d_K = 1/2 sum K_ij d_j d_i; {f,g}_K = -B_K(f,g); Q = {S_2,-}. Checked: field-count lemma (Lemma c4-count) for int(A,A*), int(lambda*,lambda), int(c*,c) on all cubic terms; Q int(d*A,d*A) = -2 int(d*dc,d*A) (table of Prop. c1-Q); Q I_3 = 0 and Q I_4 + 1/2{I_3,I_3} = 0 on random configurations; P-tree identity Q B_P(F,I_3) = B_P(QF,I_3) - B_{K_eps}(F,I_3) (from [d_P,Q] = d_{QP}, Q P(eps,oo) = K_eps); {Z, I_3} = Y_3 with Z = 2 int(A,A*) - 4 int(lambda*,lambda) - int(c*,c) (Theorem c4-log).  Bracket symmetry in this convention: {a,b} = (-1)^{|a||b|}{b,a} (e.g. {Ob_2, I_3} = {I_3, Ob_2}).
method_notes.I_b_III: I-b + III_Khat = -B_{(e^{-eps k^2}-1) K_0}(I_3, W_1^(2)(eps) - I^CT_2(eps)) = +eps B_{k^2 K_0}(I_3, Sigma_ren) + O(eps^2 log eps), Sigma_ren = lim (W_1^(2) - I^CT_2) (Step-1 Theorem c4-quadratic: finite).  Separately: eps^0: I-b +(9/4) unit B_{k^2 K_0}(I_3, int(A,A)), III_Khat the negative; eps log eps: I-b + unit B_{k^2 K_0}(I_3, Y_2), III_Khat the negative.  Numerically (ccAsV, config 0): -0.039679i, -0.0039741i, -0.00039747i at eps = 1e-4, 1e-5, 1e-6 vs predicted eps B_{k^2 K_0}(I_3, Sigma_ren) = -0.039748i, -0.0039748i, -0.00039748i, with Sigma_ren(c,A*) = (-log|k|^2 + c0) int(dc,A*), c0 = -0.27036 (numerically consistent with 1 - gamma_E - log 2 = -0.270363).
method_notes.I_d_II_b: D_2(eps) on (c at p, A|_V at -p) = i(p.a)[0 eps^-1 - (27/8)|p|^2 + (21/16) eps |p|^4 + O(eps^2)] (exact series coefficients); every other two-leg sector of degree 1 vanishes identically (Spin(4) x Spin(6) covariance of the regulator).  I-d + II-b = B_{P(eps,oo)}(D_2(eps), I_3) -> B_{P(0,oo)}(Ob_2, I_3) at generic momenta, with difference O(eps).  The tree is local: Ob_2 carries |k|^2 on the internal line and cancels the 1/|k|^2 of P(0,oo).
